title.en: Chapter 4 — The King of the Sea Horses

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: مسكت قطعة خشب وضلّيت عليها يومين.
sentences.en: I grabbed a piece of wood and stayed on it two days.
The waves threw me onto a real island.
I found people raising horses on the shore.
They took me to their king, named Mihrjan.
The king heard my story and liked me.
After months, a ship arrived at the harbour.
It was the same ship that had left me.

sentences.ar: بضاعتي كانت لسا فيها، ورجعت لبغداد غني.
sentences.en: My goods were still on it, and I returned to Baghdad rich.
